raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Plant-Based Muscle Gain Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle hypertrophy and strength gain on plant-based diet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper body hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench Press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bent-Over Row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Overhead Press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat Pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell Bicep Curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Tricep Pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower body hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back Squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian Deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg Press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Hamstring Curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Calf Raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper body accessory": 
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Incline Dumbbell Press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated Cable Row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lateral Raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Face Pull 3x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hammer Curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Skull Crusher 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          tricep_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper body hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench Press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bent-Over Row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Overhead Press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat Pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell Fly 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Tricep Dip (machine or bench) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower body hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front Squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian Deadlift 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg Extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hamstring Curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Calf Raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull accessories":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Incline Dumbbell Press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated Cable Row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Upright Row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Lat Raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Cable Tricep Extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper strength emphasis":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench Press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell Row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Overhead Press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Pull-Up (assisted if needed) 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower strength emphasis":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back Squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Deadlift (SSH optional if accessible) 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Leg Curl 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          Calf Raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full-body density":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell Bench 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          T-Bar Row 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Bulgarian Split Squat 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds each leg
          Romanian Deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_cooldown 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume maintenance and technique":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench Press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Barbell Row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Overhead Press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat Pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower volume lower body":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back Squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian Deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg Extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Hamstring Curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_calf_stretches 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Optional push/pull finisher":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Incline Dumbbell Press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated Cable Row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lateral Raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_and chest stretch 60 seconds

NUTRITION PLAN
- Daily protein target: 150g from plant sources only
- Calorie target: maintain slight surplus based on body weight and activity (adjust weekly)
- Protein sources include: soy products (tofu, tempeh, edamame, soy milk/yogurt fortified), legume varieties (lentils, chickpeas, beans), quinoa, seitan (if tolerated), peas, hemp/chia seeds, peanut/almond butter, protein blends with rice/pea blends
- Protein parsing example (example day):
  - Breakfast: Tofu scramble with veggies + 1 slice whole-grain toast
  - Snack: Protein smoothie with pea protein, fortified plant milk, banana, peanut butter
  - Lunch: Lentil curry with quinoa + vegetables
  - Snack: Edamame + handful of nuts
  - Dinner: Tempeh stir-fry with mixed vegetables and brown rice
  - Evening (optional): Protein-rich pudding with soy yogurt and hemp seeds
- Meal timing: distribute 0.25–0.3g protein per kg body weight per meal across 5–6 meals for ~150g/day
- Micronutrients: ensure B12 supplementation, vitamin D as needed, iron from plant sources with vitamin C, omega-3 from algae-based supplement
- Hydration: 2.5–3.5 liters per day, adjust for activity and sweat
- Supplements (optional): creatine monohydrate 3–5g daily (compatible with vegan diet), vegan protein powder to hit targets

CLIENT INFO
- Age: 26
- Sex: Female
- Training experience: Recreational lifter
- Diet: Vegan (no animal products)
- Goals: Muscle gain, 12 weeks
- Environment: Full gym access

Notes
- Ensure form and progression are monitored; substitute any exercise due to equipment or injury.
- If protein target feels difficult on some days, temporarily adjust calories and use higher protein density meals.
- Weekly check-ins to adjust volume, intensity, and nutrition targets.
